engineering_prior.policy: bounded simulation and ablation priors only; target hardware measurements override them

reuse: robot USD, collision matrix and qualified provisional actuator skeleton
66D actor observation and 83D critic state layouts
11D Cartesian plus five-dimensional hand action layout
do_not_reuse: independent fruit geometry or mass sampling

policy_interface.future_ablation: 5D versus 8D only after per-dimension saturation audit

training_curriculum.classification: training-only mechanics curriculum with public-capacity and strict-retention-margin reward normalization; not a crop prior or acceptance relaxation
training_curriculum.retention_margin_score: geometric mean of normalized center-distance and relative-speed margins; exactly zero at either unchanged strict retention boundary

applies_to.bending_torsion: 10% at update 0 then smoothstep to 100% at update 40, but only when the current 120 Hz state satisfies both strict thumb-plus-other-finger secure support and the unchanged retained distance/speed predicates; every other state remains 100%

training_curriculum.basis: repairs 21-23 used one low scale for all fracture modes and learned a pure-pull shortcut. Repairs 24-40 narrowed the mechanics curriculum, aligned load progress, and repaired deployable observability. Repair 39's current controller tracking error materially improved public-tail speed and distance, so it is retained. Repair 40's additional previous tracking error was rejected because it regressed joint-ready outcomes. Repair 41 then isolated temporary assistance to torsion, but through update 17 its torsion-curriculum-assisted fracture rate and grasped-break reward remained exactly zero. Repair 42 restored bending-plus-torsion assistance and tested cumulative axial wrist rotation; its public tail regressed speed and produced no retention, so that observation is removed. Repair 43 corrects a separate 120 Hz to 20 Hz temporal-credit defect without changing this mechanics schedule. Tensile/shear stay public throughout, and the update-40 public tail, reward weights, PPO, and acceptance predicates remain unchanged.
training_curriculum.reward_policy: reward weights and topology are unchanged; instantaneous stem-load progress is normalized to fixed public capacities and, during assisted training, credited only in a current strict-support and kinematically retained state, then modulated inside that strict envelope by the centered-and-slow retention margin

training_observation.classification: isolated Physics-v2 actor observability repair; no privileged simulator state and no change to the frozen Clean-v5/V1 interface
added_actor_blocks: previous normalized perceived fruit-center position relative to the palm (3D)
current and previous normalized perceived fruit-center position relative to the fingertip centroid in the palm frame (6D)
current normalized controller command-to-actual end-effector tracking error in local one-action-step units (6D)
two most recently issued bounded policy commands, newest first (22D)
training_observation.current_actor_block: current normalized perceived fruit-center position relative to the palm (3D, inherited first block)
training_observation.inherited_action_block: previous command actually applied by the delayed actuator surrogate (11D)
training_observation.reset_semantics: both previous perceived relative-position samples equal their current samples and both issued-command history slots are zero on the first observation after reset
training_observation.basis: repair33 added current/previous perceived fruit position relative to the palm, repair34 exposed the finite actuator queue, and repair37 added fingertip-centroid-relative motion. Repair38's episode clock was rejected. Repair39 appended current command-to-actual end-effector position and rotation error and improved the exact-public tail over repair37. Repair40's previous tracking-error sample produced no retained outcome and regressed joint-ready, so it remains removed. Repair42's cumulative axial wrist rotation also produced no retained outcome and regressed exact-public mean break speed to 0.8421 m/s, so it is removed. Repair43 returns to the evidenced repair39 observation contract; exact fruit orientation/velocity, stem wrench, damage, detachment, sampled delay, and acceptance thresholds remain hidden.

training_shaping.classification: training-only physics-normalized dense shaping; no mechanics, termination, retention, success, or acceptance relaxation

load_bearing_opposition.score_topology: equal blend of inherited 0.60N contact-opposition score and physical-load opposition score, bounded_0_to_1, inherited_best_ever_progress
load_bearing_opposition.basis: repair-19 learned frequent secure contact and occasional joint-ready fracture, but the inherited opposed score saturated at 0.60 N per side while V2 requires approximately 0.60-5.87 N per side for static load support; a direct replacement was rejected after five repair-20 updates because it reduced early break opposition score from about 0.04 to 0.0006, so preserve half of the inherited contact-discovery landscape and use the remaining half for actual per-environment load-bearing progress

training_policy.classification: Physics-v2-only temporal-memory repair; PPO optimizer, losses, rewards, physics, thresholds, action space, and observation values are unchanged
training_policy.actor_model: single-layer GRU followed by the inherited 512-256-128 ELU MLP head
training_policy.basis: repair43 restored exact 120 Hz fracture credit and produced nonzero retention-progress reward while terminal-only retained logging remained zero. The deployable actor has no detachment flag and must change behavior across a partially observable fracture-to-retention sequence; recurrent state is the smallest direct correction and avoids accumulating more redundant manual history observations.

training_objective.classification: Physics-v2-only component schedule correction: terminal failures, stable detach, success and the strict fracture bridge stay aligned while the dense per-step cost stays at its bounded discovery endpoint
training_objective.basis: Repair46 completed healthily but failed: its fully public tail had zero retained or successful outcomes, only one joint-ready-positive update, mean reward -27.728 and mean value loss 26.485. Preserving the strict one-shot break bridge was necessary but insufficient because repair45 also strengthened the dense time cost from -0.01 to -0.10 per nonterminal step; at the tail this contributed about -14.7 per episode and value loss remained over five times repair44's 4.666. Terminal failure alignment is independently supported by the drop reduction from repair44's 1.519% to repair45/46's 0.532%/0.507%. Repair47 therefore keeps those terminal penalties, stable-detach/success alignment and the strict fracture bridge unchanged, while retaining only the original bounded -0.01 anti-stall time cost. No reward term, endpoint weight, physics, PPO setting, predicate or acceptance threshold changes.

training.convergence_policy: two consecutive deterministic multi-seed evaluations >= 90%, <= 1 percentage point apart, plus two consecutive 100-vs-100 training-curve plateaus

blockers: A7 controller response and command latency fit
deployed L20/G20 alias resolution plus command/joint response and effort fit
deployed fingertip-pad x target-tomato dry/wet friction
deployed fingertip-pad x target-tomato indentation stiffness and damping
